nodes.summary: For every finite coloring of $\mathbb{N} = \{0, 1, 2, \dots\}$ there are disjoint infinite sets $A, B \subseteq \mathbb{N}$ such that $A \cup B \cup (A + B)$ is monochromatic, where $A + B = \{a + b : a \in A, b \in B\}$.
nodes.title: Disjoint infinite sets with monochromatic union and sumset

nodes.summary: For every finite coloring of $\mathbb{N} = \{0, 1, 2, \dots\}$ there is an infinite set $A \subseteq \mathbb{N}$ whose set of finite sums $\mathrm{FS}(A) = \{\sum_{a \in F} a : F \subseteq A \text{ finite and nonempty}\}$ is monochromatic.
nodes.title: Hindman's finite sums theorem

nodes.summary: For every finite coloring of $\mathbb{N} = \{0, 1, 2, \dots\}$ there is an infinite set $A \subseteq \mathbb{N}$ such that $A \cup \{a + a' : a, a' \in A, a \ne a'\}$ is monochromatic.
nodes.title: Pairwise sum theorem

nodes.summary: For ultrafilters $U$, $V$ on $\mathbb{N} = \{0, 1, 2, \dots\}$ and $X \subseteq \mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N}$, write $X \in U \otimes V$ when $\{n : \{m : (n, m) \in X\} \in V\} \in U$. nodes.title: Interleaved sequences and tensor products of ultrafilters

For $X \subseteq \mathbb{N}^+$ let $\mathrm{FS}(X)$ be the set of sums of nonempty finite subsets of $X$. nodes.title: PR-witnesses of the finite sums family

nodes.summary: An ultrafilter $W$ on $\mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N}$, where $\mathbb{N} = \{0, 1, 2, \dots\}$, is a Ramsey's witness when every $X \in W$ contains $\{(h, h') \in H \times H : h < h'\}$ for some infinite $H \subseteq \mathbb{N}$. nodes.title: PR-witnesses of the pairwise sum family

nodes.summary: For an ultrafilter $U$ on $\mathbb{N} = \{0, 1, 2, \dots\}$, the tensor square $U \otimes U$ is the ultrafilter on $\mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N}$ whose members are the sets $X$ with $\{n : \{m : (n, m) \in X\} \in U\} \in U$. nodes.title: Ramsey's witnesses are the closure of tensor squares

nodes.summary: Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a family of subsets of a set $S$. Every finite coloring of $S$ has a monochromatic member of $\mathcal{F}$ (that is, $\mathcal{F}$ is weakly partition regular) if and only if there is an ultrafilter $U$ on $S$ such that every $A \in U$ contains some member of $\mathcal{F}$ ($U$ is a PR-witness of $\mathcal{F}$).
nodes.title: Partition regular families and ultrafilters

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
